caption: Unpopular opinion: your Game of the Year can be an old game. Agree or disagree? #hottake #gameoftheyear #newyear #minecraft #gaming #fyp

instagram.caption:
Unpopular opinion: your Game of the Year can be an old game.

Stardew Valley is a decade old and still everywhere. The release date doesn't decide what's great. Minecraft is about 15 years old and still one of the most played games every single year. If Skyrim gave you the most fun this year, that is your Game of the Year. Agree?
